{{Quote|You are the best; the elite.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to members of The Muunilinst 10|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 2">{{CW|2}}</ref>}}
'''CT-43/002''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] and member of [[The Muunilinst 10]], a mixed group of elite [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] and regular clone troopers that participated in a [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were tasked with capturing a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] emplacement, but the clones' [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] was shot down by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]. In the ensuing [[Lightfight|firefight]] with [[battle droid assassin]]s, CT-43/002 was [[Death/Legends|killed]]; however, the rest of the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] survived the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] attack and eventually completed their mission. Later, The Muunilinst 10 leader, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fordo]], transferred his [[Chancellor's Service Medal]] to CT-43/002 posthumously.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Banking Clan has hidden huge factories on Muunilinst, building huge droid armies and massive warships. We must act quickly!|Obi-Wan Kenobi, briefing the clone troopers before the battle|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 1">{{CW|1}}</ref>}}
[[File:FordoHelmetshot.jpg|thumb|right|200px|CT-43/002 served under clone Captain Fordo (pictured).]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]<ref name="Databank" /> CT-43/002<ref name="GtGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|led]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] to the planet [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], where the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] was manufacturing substantial [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CW1">{{CW|1}}</ref> CT-43/002 was among the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] dispatched to Muunilinst and was chosen as a member of [[The Muunilinst 10]], a special task force of seven clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and two [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fordo]]. Acting independently from the rest of the clone troopers, The Muunilinst 10 was supposed to aid the Republic in achieving a swift victory by capturing a Separatist [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] emplacement on the surface of the planet.<ref name="GtGAR" /> Before the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] reached its destination, Kenobi personally reminded the task force of the utmost importance of its mission.<ref name="CW2">{{CW|2}}</ref>

After arriving at Muunilinst, [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and many [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] engaged the Banking Clan's [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class starfighters]] above the planet, while Kenobi's ground troops utilized [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] to reach the planet's surface. As the Republic forces headed toward the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Harnaidan]], Kenobi ordered CT-43/002 and The Muunilinst 10 to break off and proceed with their mission. Once in Harnaidan, however, their [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] was shot down by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] and crashed in one of the city's streets. All members of The Muunilinst 10 survived the crash and, following Fordo's order, disembarked from the downed [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="CW2" />

[[File:CW_Chapter_3.png|thumb|left|240px|CT-43/002 is killed.]]
At that moment, [[battle droid assassin]]s who had been hiding in the nearby buildings opened fire on the clone troopers. The clones quickly started shooting back in retaliation, but CT-43/002 was soon [[Death/Legends|killed]] by enemy fire. The other members of their unit survived the attack and managed to destroy the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Fordo and<ref name="CW3" /> his<ref name="GtGAR" /> surviving men then proceeded to destroy the [[Harnaidan defensive cannon|Confederate artillery cannon]],<ref name="CW3" /> rendezvoused with Kenobi,<ref name="CW4">{{CW|4}}</ref> and helped the Jedi capture the Banking Clan leader, [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]].<ref name="CW9">{{CW|9}}</ref> By the end of the battle, CT-43/002 was the squad's only casualty.<ref name="CW3" /> Later, Fordo was awarded the [[Chancellor's Service Medal]] for his actions at the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]], but transferred the award posthumously to CT-43/002.<ref name="GtGAR" />

==Personality and traits==
Like all of Jango Fett's clones, CT-43/002 stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> The trooper was chosen to be a member of The Muunilinst 10, a unit considered to be elite by [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi.<ref name="CW2" />

==Equipment==
CT-43/002 wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and wielded a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] in combat.<ref name="CW3" />

==Behind the scenes==
CT-43/002 first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[Chapter 2 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|second episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' animated television series,<ref name="CW2" /> which premiered on [[November 10]], [[2003]].<ref name="TV.com">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-ii-275355|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 1, Episode 2: Chapter II}}</ref> The "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]" article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 84|''Star Wars Insider'' 84]]<ref name="GtGAR" /> on [[September 26]], [[2005]],<ref name="SW date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> later identified them as CT-43/002.<ref name="GtGAR" />
